verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं राघवेण सुभाषितम् ।इदं शुभतरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महेश्वरः ।। ६.१२२.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā śubhaṁ vākyaṁ rāghaveṇa subhāṣitam ।idaṁ śubhataraṁ vākyaṁ vyājahāra maheśvaraḥ ।। 6.122.1 ।।

translations.english: On hearing the sweet reply of Raghava, Lord Maheswara delivered an auspicious message.
translations.hindi: न युद्धकारड का एकसो चोदहवॉ सर्ग पूरा हुआ । नकि पञ्चुदशोत्तरशततमः सग: र्‍ण&8- ते रावणवधं दृष्टा देवगन्धर्वदानवाः । जग्मु! स्वेः स्वैिमानैस्ते कथयन्तः शुभाः कथाः

verses.sloka: पुष्कराक्ष महाबाहो महावक्षः परन्तप ।दिष्ट्या कृतमिदं कर्म त्वया शस्त्रभृतां वर ।। ६.१२२.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: puṣkarākṣa mahābāho mahāvakṣaḥ parantapa ।diṣṭyā kṛtamidaṁ karma tvayā śastrabhṛtāṁ vara ।। 6.122.2 ।।

translations.english: "O Lotuseyed, mighty armed, broadchested, a subduer of enemies, by good luck you have performed this action."
translations.hindi: रावण का भयङ्कर वध, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का पराक्रम, वानर्रो का भली भाति लड़ना, सुग्रीव को सुमंत्रणा, श्रीराम चन्द्र जी के प्रति लक्ष्मण और हनुमान जी का अनुराग (या स्बामि भक्तलायल्टी ) ओर इन दोनों के बल पराक्रम को कथा कहते तथा आनन्दित होते हुए वे समस्त महाभाग ( देवगण ' जहाँ से आए थे वहाँ चले गए

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः ।अपावृत्तं त्वया सङ्ख्ये राम रावणजं भयम् ।। ६.१२२.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṁ dāruṇaṁ tamaḥ ।apāvṛttaṁ tvayā saṅkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṁ bhayam ।। 6.122.3 ।।

translations.english: "The dread of Ravana in all the worlds which caused gloom and fear has been fortunately removed by you in the war."

verses.sloka: आश्वास्य भरतं दीनं कौसल्यां च यशस्विनीम् ।कैकेयीं च सुमित्रां च दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातरम् ।। ६.१२२.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: āśvāsya bharataṁ dīnaṁ kausalyāṁ ca yaśasvinīm ।kaikeyīṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamātaram ।। 6.122.4 ।।

translations.english: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने, इन्द्र के भेजे हुए दिव्य और अभ्नि के समान चमचसाते रथ को लोटा कर ले जाने के लिए मातलि को ध्याज्ञा दी और उसका सत्कार भो ।कअआ

verses.sloka: प्राप्य राज्यमयोध्यायां नन्दयित्वा सुहृज्जनम् ।इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले वंशं स्थापयित्वा महाबल ।। ६.१२२.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāpya rājyamayodhyāyāṁ nandayitvā suhṛjjanam ।ikṣvākūṇāṁ kule vaṁśaṁ sthāpayitvā mahābala ।। 6.122.5 ।।

translations.english: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.
translations.hindi: जब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने इन्द्र के सारथि मातलि को रथ लौटा कर ले जाने की आज्ञा दी, तब वह उस दिव्य रथ पर सवार हो स्वगे को चला गया

verses.sloka: इष्ट्वा तुरगमेधेन प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः ।ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा त्रिदिवं गन्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.१२२.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṁ yaśaḥ ।brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṁ dattvā tridivaṁ gantumarhasi ।। 6.122.6 ।।

translations.english: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.
translations.hindi: क्र - ई र ति न देवताओं के सारथिश्रेष्ठ मातलि के स्वगचले जाने के बाद, श्रीरासचन्द जी ने परमप्रसन्न हो सुम्रीव को अपनी छाती से लगाया

verses.sloka: एष राजा विमानस्थः पिता दशरथस्तव ।काकुत्स्थ मानुषे लोके गुरुस्तव महायशाः ।। ६.१२२.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa rājā vimānasthaḥ pitā daśarathastava ।kākutstha mānuṣe loke gurustava mahāyaśāḥ ।। 6.122.7 ।।

translations.english: "O Kakuthsa! Here is your father, teacher in the mortal world, king Dasharatha seated in the aerial car."
translations.hindi: सुम्रीव को गले लगा, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी, लक्ष्मण जी के कहने से अहो गए जहां वानरी सेना छावनी डाले पड़ी थी

verses.sloka: इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय ।। ६.१२२.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: indralokaṁ gataḥ śrīmāṁstvayā putreṇa tāritaḥ ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā tvamenamabhivādaya ।। 6.122.8 ।।

translations.english: "Liberated by you, his son, the glorious emperor has reached Indra's world. You with your brother Lakshmana offer your salutations to him."
translations.hindi: अब्रवीच तदा रामः समीपपरिवर्तिनम्‌। . | ०० भमिति ससन, लकषम दी पते लघ्तसू॥।॥॥७० पञ्चदशो त्तरश्श्ततसः सगः १२३१ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने वहाँ पहुँच अपने पाश्यवर्ती सुमित्रानन्दन, बलवान्‌ ओर तेज से दीप्रिमान्‌ लक्ष्मण से कहा ।।=॥ बिभीषणमिम सोम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय । ग्रनुरक्त च भक्तं च मम चेवोपकारिणम्‌

verses.sloka: महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः ।विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत् पितुः ।। ६.१२२.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ ।vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmamakarot pituḥ ।। 6.122.9 ।।

translations.english: Raghava along with Lakshmana offered salutations to his father seated on top of the aerial chariot after listening to Lord MahaDeva.

verses.sloka: दीप्यमानं स्वया लक्ष्म्या विरजोम्बरधारिणम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं विभुः ।। ६.१२२.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: dīpyamānaṁ svayā lakṣmyā virajombaradhāriṇam ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dadarśa pitaraṁ vibhuḥ ।। 6.122.10 ।।

translations.english: Raghava with his younger brother Lakshmana saw his father who was effulgent, blazing and adorned in white clothes.

verses.sloka: हर्षेण महता ऽ ऽविष्टो विमानस्थो महीपतिः ।प्राणैः प्रियतरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं दशरथस्तदा ।। ६.१२२.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā ' 'viṣṭo vimānastho mahīpatiḥ ।prāṇaiḥ priyataraṁ dṛṣṭvā putraṁ daśarathastadā ।। 6.122.11 ।।

translations.english: Then Dasaratha, the ruler of the world, seated in an elevated seat in the aerial car, seeing his son who was dearer than life to him, extremely rejoiced and made Raghava sit on his lap, embraced him, and started speaking as follows.
translations.hindi: जब मद्गात्मा श्रोरास चन्द्र जी ने इस प्रकार कहा, तंत्र लक्ष्मण जी ने कहा-- बहुत अच्छा ” ओर पक सुवणेकलश उठा लिआ

verses.sloka: आरोप्याङ्कं महाबाहुर्वरासनगतः प्रभुः ।बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य ततो वाक्यं समाददे ।। ६.१२२.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: āropyāṅkaṁ mahābāhurvarāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ ।bāhubhyāṁ sampariṣvajya tato vākyaṁ samādade ।। 6.122.12 ।।

translations.english: Then Dasaratha, the ruler of the world, seated in an elevated seat in the aerial car, seeing his son who was dearer than life to him, extremely rejoiced and made Raghava sit on his lap, embraced him, and started speaking as follows.

verses.sloka: न मे स्वर्गो बहुमतः सम्मानश्च सुरर्षिभिः ।त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते ।। ६.१२२.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: na me svargo bahumataḥ sammānaśca surarṣibhiḥ ।tvayā rāma vihīnasya satyaṁ pratiśṛṇomi te ।। 6.122.13 ।।

translations.english: "Rama separated from you, even the suras and sages honouring me in heaven does not give me happiness. It is true and I promise."
translations.hindi: उस सुवर्णं कलश को मन के समान शीघ्र चलने बाले वान- रेद्रो को देकर उनसे कहा कि, ( इसमें ) चारों समुद्रों का ज़ल ले आओ ॥१२!) । हाकु, 6 १ समुद्राच्चतुः- समुद्रेभ्य इत्यथः | ( रा० , १२३२ युद्धकाण्डे अतिशीघं ततो गत्वा वानरास्ते महाबलाः । आमतास्तज्जेल गृद्य समुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः

verses.sloka: अद्य त्वां निहतामित्रं दृष्ट्वा सम्पूर्णमानसम् ।निस्तीर्णवनवासं च प्रीतिरासीत् परा मम ।। ६.१२२.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya tvāṁ nihatāmitraṁ dṛṣṭvā sampūrṇamānasam ।nistīrṇavanavāsaṁ ca prītirāsīt parā mama ।। 6.122.14 ।।

translations.english: "Today the enemies are killed, and you have completed the exile. I am fully satisfied and experiencing joyfulness on seeing you."
translations.hindi: तब लक्ष्मण जी ने विभोषण को राजसिहापन पर बिठा कर समुदों के जल से भरे हुए कलसों में से एक कलते के जल से विभीषण का अभिषेक किआ

verses.sloka: कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर ।तव प्रवाजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम ।। ६.१२२.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kaikeyyā yāni coktāni vākyāni vadatāṁ vara ।tava pravājanārthāni sthitāni hṛdaye mama ।। 6.122.15 ।।

translations.english: "Those utterances of Kaikeyi with a motive to send you on exile are still hurting my heart, O Best among speakers!"
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--११ और १२ वें श्लोकों में एक बचन में “ घट का प्रयोग होने पर भी १२ वें श्लोक में “ वानरेन्द्राणां ” और १० वें श्लोक में “ ततस्त्वेकं ” को देख, समुद्र जल लाने के लिए वानरों को दिया जाना सिद्ध होता हे । ] न सङ्कायां,रक्षसां मध्ये राजानं रामशासनात्‌ । 'बिधिना मन्त्रहष्टेन सुहृदगणममाष्टृतम्‌

verses.sloka: त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम् ।अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तो ऽस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः ।। ६.१२२.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṁ pariṣvajya salakṣmaṇam ।adya duḥkhādvimukto 'smi nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ ।। 6.122.16 ।।

translations.english: "Seeing you with Lakshmana and embracing you makes me happy freed from grief just as the sun freed from mist."

verses.sloka: तारितो ऽहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना ।अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा तारितो ब्राह्मणो यथा ।। ६.१२२.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tārito 'haṁ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā ।aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā tārito brāhmaṇo yathā ।। 6.122.17 ।।

translations.english: "Son! I am liberated by you today, my great son, just as Kahola who was set on righteousness was liberated by Ashtavakra."

verses.sloka: इदानीं तु विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः ।वधार्थं रावणस्येदं विहितं पुरुषोत्तम ।। ६.१२२.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: idānīṁ tu vijānāmi yathā saumya sureśvaraiḥ ।vadhārthaṁ rāvaṇasyedaṁ vihitaṁ puruṣottama ।। 6.122.18 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle son! I did not know that the ruler of gods had sent you for the destruction of Ravana, O excellent one."
translations.hindi: जब लङ्का की प्रजा को ढाढम बंत्रा ( लक्ष्मण को साथ लिए हुए ) श्राराम चन्द्र जो के समीप आए ; तत्र अक्षत, लड्डू, धान की खील ( लावा ) तथा दिव्यपुष्यों को ले कर

verses.sloka: सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम् ।वनान्निवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यत्यरिनिषूदन ।। ६.१२२.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: siddhārthā khalu kausalyā yā tvāṁ rāma gṛhaṁ gatam ।vanānnivṛttaṁ saṁhṛṣṭā drakṣyatyariniṣūdana ।। 6.122.19 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! Kausalya will see you, as an accomplished one, as a destroyer of enemies, on returning home from the forest and will be highly rejoiced."

verses.sloka: सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम् ।जलार्द्रमभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ति वसुधाधिपम् ।। ६.१२२.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṁ purīṁ gatam ।jalārdramabhiṣiktaṁ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam ।। 6.122.20 ।।

translations.english: "On reaching the city and consecrated in the kingdom as ruler of the world, people will see you as an accomplished person."

verses.sloka: अनुरक्तेन बलिना शुचिना धर्मचारिणा ।इच्छामि त्वामहं द्रष्टुं भरतेन समागतम् ।। ६.१२२.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: anuraktena balinā śucinā dharmacāriṇā ।icchāmi tvāmahaṁ draṣṭuṁ bharatena samāgatam ।। 6.122.21 ।।

translations.english: "I desire to see you reunited with mighty Bharata who is pure and follower of dharma."
translations.hindi: और उनको प्रसन्न करने के लिए उन सब द्रव्यो को ग्रहण कर लिआ । तदनन्तर पवत के समान बगल में खड़े हुए बीर

verses.sloka: चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य वने निर्यापितास्त्वया ।वसता सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता ।। ६.१२२.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa samāḥ saumya vane niryāpitāstvayā ।vasatā sītayā sārdhaṁ lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā ।। 6.122.22 ।।

translations.english: "O Gentle Rama! Fourteen years have been spent in the forest with Sita and Lakshmana after my departure from life."
translations.hindi: चान्र हनुमान जी से श्रीरामचन्द्र जी बोले; हे सोम्य ! तुम महाराज विभीषण से आज्ञा माँग कर, लंका में जाओ और रावण के घर में घुस कर तुम मेरे विज्ञय का संवाद सुना कर, सीता को आनन्दित करो

verses.sloka: निवृत्तवनवासो ऽसि प्रतिज्ञा सफला कृता ।रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवास्ते परितोषिताः ।। ६.१२२.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nivṛttavanavāso 'si pratijñā saphalā kṛtā ।rāvaṇaṁ ca raṇe hatvā devāste paritoṣitāḥ ।। 6.122.23 ।।

translations.english: "The period of your exile has been completed, my promise has been fulfilled in the battlefield and the gods have also gratified you."

verses.sloka: कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाध्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन ।भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि ।इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् ।। ६.१२२.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṁ karma yaśaḥ ślādhyaṁ prāptaṁ te śatrusūdana ।bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājyastho dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi ।iti bruvāṇaṁ rājānaṁ rāmaḥ prāñjalirabravīt ।। 6.122.24 ।।

translations.english: O slayer of foes, you have accomplished a praiseworthy deed and won fame; now, established in your kingdom with your brothers, enjoy a long life.

verses.sloka: कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च ।सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया ।। ६.१२२.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kuru prasādaṁ dharmajña kaikeyyā bharatasya ca ।saputrāṁ tvāṁ tyajāmīti yaduktā kaikayī tvayā ।। 6.122.25 ।।

translations.english: Dasaratha having spoken to Rama, offered salutations with joined palms and said," You are righteous. Be gracious to Bharata and Kaikeyi also."

verses.sloka: स शापः केकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत् प्रभो ।। ६.१२२.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śāpaḥ kekayīṁ ghoraḥ saputrāṁ na spṛśet prabho ।। 6.122.26 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord! You had spoken in such a way saying 'I disown a good son and Kaikeyi' and cursed. May that dreadful curse not touch your son and Kaikeyi," said Rama.

verses.sloka: स तथेति महाराजो राममुक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिम् ।लक्ष्मणं च परिष्वज्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ह ।। ६.१२२.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tatheti mahārājo rāmamuktvā kṛtāñjalim ।lakṣmaṇaṁ ca pariṣvajya punarvākyamuvāca ha ।। 6.122.27 ।।

translations.english: The king (Dasharatha) saying 'so be it' and embracing Lakshmana again and saluting Rama spoke to Lakshmana as follows.

verses.sloka: रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया ।कृता मम महाप्रीतिः प्राप्तं धर्मफलं च ते ।। ६.१२२.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmaṁ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā ।kṛtā mama mahāprītiḥ prāptaṁ dharmaphalaṁ ca te ।। 6.122.28 ।।

translations.english: "You have served with devotion to Rama and Sita and made me very happy. By this task you have earned the merit of righteousness."

verses.sloka: धर्मं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि ।रामे प्रसन्ने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथैव च ।। ६.१२२.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharmaṁ prāpsyasi dharmajña yaśaśca vipulaṁ bhuvi ।rāme prasanne svargaṁ ca mahimānaṁ tathaiva ca ।। 6.122.29 ।।

translations.english: "O knower of dharma! If Rama is pleased, extensive fame as well as heaven and supreme glory will be attained on this earth."

verses.sloka: रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन ।रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शुभेष्वभिरतः सदा ।। ६.१२२.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmaṁ śuśrūṣa bhadraṁ te sumitrānandavardhana ।rāmaḥ sarvasya lokasya śubheṣvabhirataḥ sadā ।। 6.122.30 ।।

translations.english: "O Lakshmana, the enhancer of Sumithra's joy, 'Be auspicious. Rama will always remain good in the service of the three worlds."

verses.sloka: एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।अभिगम्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।। ६.१२२.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ete sendrāstrayo lokāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।abhigamya mahātmānamarcanti puruṣottamam ।। 6.122.31 ।।

translations.english: "This Indra and also Siddhas, supreme sages who are great souls pay respects to Rama and worship him."

verses.sloka: एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् ।देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परन्तपः ।। ६.१२२.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: etattaduktamavyaktamakṣaraṁ brahmanirmitam ।devānāṁ hṛdayaṁ saumya guhyaṁ rāmaḥ parantapaḥ ।। 6.122.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Gentle! Rama, the tormentor of enemies is the unmanifest and imperishable secret, is Brahma alone. This is created by Brahma. It is the secret in the heart of gods."

verses.sloka: अवाप्तं धर्मचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया ।रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया ।। ६.१२२.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: avāptaṁ dharmacaraṇaṁ yaśaśca vipulaṁ tvayā ।rāmaṁ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā ।। 6.122.33 ।।

translations.english: "Videha's Sita, you have also earned fame by serving Rama with devotion and following the righteous path."

verses.sloka: स तथोक्त्वा महाबाहुर्लक्ष्मणं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम् ।उवाच राजा धर्मात्मा वैदेहीं वचनं शुभम् ।। ६.१२२.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tathoktvā mahābāhurlakṣmaṇaṁ prāñjaliṁ sthitam ।uvāca rājā dharmātmā vaidehīṁ vacanaṁ śubham ।। 6.122.34 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken like that to Lakshmana, looking at the daughter in law standing there with folded palms, Dasaratha addressed her saying," Daughter", gently and sweetly and said.

verses.sloka: कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति ।रामेम त्वद्विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतमेतद्धितैषिणा ।। ६.१२२.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kartavyo na tu vaidehi manyustyāgamimaṁ prati ।rāmema tvadviśuddhyarthaṁ kṛtametaddhitaiṣiṇā ।। 6.122.35 ।।

translations.english: "In the event of Rama abandoning you, resentment should not be shown in this way. It is your duty to endure. Rama himself has done this to prove your purity."

verses.sloka: न त्वं सुभ्रु समाधेया पतिशुश्रूषणं प्रति ।अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम् ।। ६.१२२.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: na tvaṁ subhru samādheyā patiśuśrūṣaṇaṁ prati ।avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyameṣa te daivataṁ param ।। 6.122.36 ।।

translations.english: "Daughter! that which you have done is a sign of your character. It is highly difficult to do. You will overshadow the future of other women."

verses.sloka: इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम् ।इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन् ।। ६.१२२.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti pratisamādiśya putrau sītāṁ tathā snuṣām ।indralokaṁ vimānena yayau daśaratho jvalan ।। 6.122.37 ।।

translations.english: "You need not be told about the service to your husband. Nevertheless, I am giving instruction. This Rama is supreme god for you."

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्वाविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe dvāviṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 122 ।।

translations.english: Having admonished the two glowing sons, and Sita, Dasaratha went by aerial car to the world of Indra.
